SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT C.*, (SELECT ORG.ORGNAME FROM T_CORE_ORG ORG WHERE ORG.ID = O.CORPID) AS CORPNAME, (SELECT U.USERNAME FROM T_CORE_USER U WHERE U.ID = C.CONTRACTORDERER) AS CONTRACTORDERERNAME, O.DOMAINID, O.REQCYCLE, O.AUTHORIZATIONUNIT, O.PROJECTNAME, O.SAMPLESOURCE, O.CREATEDBYNAME, O.BIDDER, O.BIDDERNAME, O.CUSTOMERID, O.OPPORTUNITYNO, O.IMPLEMENTATIONTIMES, O.REMAININGFREQUENCY, O.SCANNEDCOPYOFCONTRACT, O.ORIGINALCONTRACT, O.CUSTOMERNAME, O.CORPID, O.REQSUBTYP FROM T_CRM_OPPORTUNITY_CONTRACT C LEFT JOIN T_CRM_OPPORTUNITY_MAIN O ON O.ID = C.OPPORTUNITYID) T
AND exists(select 1 from t_crm_opportunity_main o where o.id = t.opportunityid and o.contractflag = '1' )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM LIMS_CRM_YMJC.T_CORE_FILE T
TARGETID = #{targetId}
ORDER BY
T.ID
